SELECT SUBSTR(CM.YM,1,4) || '-' || SUBSTR(CM.YM,5,2) AS YYYYMM, NVL(AA.CNT,0) AS CNT1, --채팅수 NVL(BB.CNT,0) AS CNT2, --게시글수 NVL(AA.CNT,0) + NVL(BB.CNT,0) AS TCNT --합계 FROM ( SELECT TO_CHAR( ADD_MONTHS( TO_DATE(#{startDate},'YYYYMMDD'), LEVEL - 1 ), 'YYYYMM') YM FROM DUAL CONNECT BY LEVEL <= MONTHS_BETWEEN(TO_DATE(#{endDate},'YYYYMMDD'),TO_DATE(#{startDate},'YYYYMMDD')) + 1 ) CM, ( SELECT TO_CHAR(FRST_REG_DT, 'YYYYMM') YM, COUNT(*) CNT --채팅수 FROM AYB200 WHERE 1=1 AND DEL_YN = 'N' AND FRST_REG_DT >= TO_DATE(#{startDate} || '000000', 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') AND FRST_REG_DT <= TO_DATE(#{endDate} || '235959', 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS')
AND SXDC_SE_CD = 'M'
AND SXDC_SE_CD = 'F'
-- AND SXDC_SE_CD IS NULL GROUP BY TO_CHAR(FRST_REG_DT, 'YYYYMM') ) AA, ( --01솔로봇 02솔로봇채팅 03이음e 04웹심리검사 05비밀 --08댓글상담실 12사이버상담후기 14고민해결백과 15자녀맘터치법 --(내담자가 등록하지 않은 게시판: 18오픈채팅 31네이버 35아웃리치 36구글) SELECT TO_CHAR(FRST_REG_DT, 'YYYYMM') YM, COUNT(*) CNT --게시글수 FROM AYE100 WHERE 1=1 AND DEL_YN = 'N' AND FRST_REG_DT >= TO_DATE(#{startDate} || '000000', 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') AND FRST_REG_DT <= TO_DATE(#{endDate} || '235959', 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') AND BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD IN ('01','02','03','04','05','08','12','14','15')
AND SXDC_SE_CD = 'M'
AND SXDC_SE_CD = 'F'
-- AND SXDC_SE_CD IS NULL GROUP BY TO_CHAR(FRST_REG_DT, 'YYYYMM') ) BB WHERE 1=1 AND CM.YM = AA.YM(+) AND CM.YM = BB.YM(+) ORDER BY YYYYMM DESC
